rationale: POST /addContact JSON body field `country` is rendered/evaluated through a Java EL or template engine on the server. A custom WAF filter strips many tokens, but the official solver crafts payloads using indirection (java.lang.Character#toString chains, substring tables) to bypass the WAF and ultimately call Runtime.exec(). Classic SSTI / expression-language injection.
